concerns.location: tasks.md:T104 (and Notes, 'MNAR simulation uses ORIGINAL (unpermuted) outcome values')
concerns.text: T104 and the Notes section hard-code the plan's MNAR override (original outcome values) while spec FR-002 and the spec's MNAR Assumption both state 'missingness probability MUST depend on the permuted outcome values.' The plan itself says 'The spec must be updated to reflect this' — no spec revision exists, so the task list enforces a direct weakening of an unamended FR. Either amend the spec first or make the task conditional on the spec being corrected.

FR-003 mandates '500 Monte Carlo iterations per condition'; T102 uses 500 but T104 (the full sweep) never states an iteration count, and plan.md targets 2000. A task claiming FR-004/FR-008/SC-002 coverage with an unstated or 2000-iteration count either violates FR-003 or silently relaxes it. State the iteration count in T104 and reconcile it with FR-003 (or amend the spec).

concerns.location: tasks.md:T104 verification ('exactly 72 condition records (per dataset)') vs spec.md:FR-008
concerns.text: FR-008 defines the FDR family as 'all 72 simulation conditions (8 rates x 3 mechanisms x 3 methods)' with no dataset dimension, but T104 expects 72 records per dataset (≥3 datasets per plan). The actual BH correction family is 72 × n_datasets (≥216), which does not match the FR-008 correction scope the task claims to satisfy. Specify the FDR family explicitly and reconcile with FR-008.

SC-001's pass threshold (CC under MCAR ≤ 0.06, a 20% relative increase) has no verification step anywhere: T103 tests only the 0.055 tipping-point threshold and T106 tests SC-005's cc_mi_ratio. A success criterion is silently dropped from the task list. Add an SC-001 check (e.g., in T106 or T109) reporting CC-under-MCAR error against the ≤0.06 threshold.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T101 vs spec.md:Edge Cases (MNAR / fully observed outcome)
concerns.text: The spec's Edge Cases require generating synthetic outcome values when MNAR cannot be simulated on fully observed outcomes, while the Assumptions forbid it; the plan's override resolves this only implicitly. T101/T106 do not state which behavior is implemented, leaving an unresolved spec contradiction for the implementer. Document the resolution in the task (or amend the spec).
